args.body: Use archive-evidence-navigation.json if the queued inventory commits. Read the original candidate receipts and bind the L369 run to the decoded archive hash before carrying its result forward. If the link remains uncertain but the intended archive and each member's redistribution authority are evidenced, execute that archive from a clean extraction and use the new receipt to finish the private listing under the existing valid lease. If the input budget refuses the inventory, use the pinned catalog and select the identified candidate paths directly. If a specific right or identity record is missing, record that dependency and finish the seller economics supported by the captured official terms. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Public release remains subject to independent review.

description: The treasury reports zero verified available funds and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Recovering that link can move the existing checkout test toward a private listing without spending. Seller activation depends on the documented account requirements, and public release depends on independent review.
